newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan domestic vehicle output up 19.3% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan domestic vehicle output up 19.3% yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's domestic vehicle production in January rose 19.3 percent from a year earlier to 917,798 vehicles, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers' Association (JAMA) said on Monday.
It was the fifth successive month in which output had risen on a year-on-year basis.
The association said it expected Japan's vehicle exports in January to have risen about 34 percent from a year earlier. It will announce official export figures later this month.
